en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Sarry Bin Khalid, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
O Ali<sup>asws</sup>! There is no poverty more intense than the ignorance, nor a wealth more assisting than the intellect’.
